title: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte Impeachment Trial (November 20, 2026)
summary: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte will continue on Friday, November 20, 2026.

blocks.text: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Day 45: What to expect
The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to present its last three witnesses for the week on Friday, November 20.

For the 45th day of the impeachment, the defense lawyers will present Department of Trade and Industry Undersecretary for Industry Development and Investment Promotions Group Ceferino Rodolfo and Food and Drug Administration Center for Food Regulation and Research director Pilar Marilyn Pagayunan.

Meanwhile, Department Manager III Rowena Mendoza from the Center for International Expositions and Missions (CITEM) of the Golden Shell Pavilion won't be able to attend due to an official trip abroad. She will be replaced by lawyer Eva Marie Mariquina.
The three witnesses will continue to testify on the status of Cale88 Foods Corporation, a declared asset of the Vice President’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio.
